ignore_reasons./generated_at_utc: Wall-clock generation timestamp; not part of the empirical claim surface.
ignore_reasons./data/common_end: yfinance period='max' live download; the common sample end date advances every trading day, so a future re-run necessarily sees a longer sample.
ignore_reasons./data: Data-window metadata (per-ticker start/end, common_start/common_end) is a function of the live download date and is not a fixed claim; the connectedness/GFEVD estimates are the empirical surface, subject to sample growth under network='allow'.
